Read-only authored corpus: content/question-qa-r2, commit 765c5dc0fa5586281047bf4f7b30d09ab3707887. The authored inventory has six subjects, 25 topics, and 158 lessons. Student-facing exam offerings and runtime availability are unconfirmed.
The stored outline has 141 lesson units and omits 17 authored lessons: 12 General Information, two data-interpretation lessons, two clerical filing lessons, and Assumptions and Conclusions. It contains an empty General Information placeholder. The original corpus tab is preserved unchanged.
The original text joins inference and fact/opinion in one bullet. Nested bullets and supporting concepts do not define separate lessons. This audited view uses the actual authored lesson units; it proposes no additions or splits.
All nine requirements passed independent source checks and organizer-first rebuilds. A fresh independent map review and all-exam counting check verified the provisional map and complete lesson accounting. Apparent gaps and partial facets remain leads for later lesson review.
Detailed sources, per-exam maps, partial matches, unresolved depth, and check records are maintained in the coverage-r1 audit on the docs/content-coverage-audit-r1 working branch. The separate source and map manifests identify the reviewed inputs.

Read-only authored corpus: content/question-qa-r2, commit 765c5dc0fa5586281047bf4f7b30d09ab3707887. The authored inventory has six subjects, 25 topics, and 158 lessons. Student-facing exam offerings and runtime availability are unconfirmed.

The stored outline has 141 lesson units and omits 17 authored lessons: 12 General Information, two data-interpretation lessons, two clerical filing lessons, and Assumptions and Conclusions. It contains an empty General Information placeholder. The original corpus tab is preserved unchanged.

The original text joins inference and fact/opinion in one bullet. Nested bullets and supporting concepts do not define separate lessons. This audited view uses the actual authored lesson units; it proposes no additions or splits.

All nine requirements passed independent source checks and organizer-first rebuilds. A fresh independent map review and all-exam counting check verified the provisional map and complete lesson accounting. Apparent gaps and partial facets remain leads for later lesson review.

Detailed sources, per-exam maps, partial matches, unresolved depth, and check records are maintained in the coverage-r1 audit on the docs/content-coverage-audit-r1 working branch. The separate source and map manifests identify the reviewed inputs.
